resources.string: Fixed gentle curve: +1 dB of sub-bass (60 Hz), −0.5 dB at 250 Hz, +0.5 dB of presence (3 kHz) and +1.5 dB of air (12 kHz). Only with the equalizer on.
Lowers the 5–9 kHz region by up to 6 dB only while the “s” sounds stand out from the rest of the mix; without them the sound is untouched. Only with the equalizer on.
